nodes.label: KPICard
nodes.rationale: Displays key performance indicators with sparkline visualization. Defines the visual language for all card components. Strict constraints on height (140px) and padding (20px).

nodes.label: ChartCard
nodes.rationale: Wrapper for chart visualizations with visual subordination to KPI cards. Maximum height: 320px.

nodes.label: DataTable
nodes.rationale: Displays tabular data with visual subordination to KPI cards. Strict row height (56px) and cell padding (12px) constraints.

nodes.label: LineChart
nodes.rationale: Displays time-series data with smooth curves. Prioritizes Revenue as primary and Orders as secondary lines.
